description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury.
Cast Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.
